chapter: Stuff Smith, 52nd Street and session work
title: 'Crescendo on Drums' begins in Stuff Smith's group
summary: The feature developed at a rehearsal with Stuff and Jonah; Walter Thomas later arranged it for Cab.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: "Crescendo on Drums," we had a rehearsal that day, and Stuff just started, he'd say okay, Cozy you do this, Jonah you do this, and we do this, and we just started in playing and then we got to further on in the piece, and things started and held together, and said oh yeah, we'll keep that in, that sounds good, and that's how it came about, just like that.
That's the same one that you later recorded with Cab.
So you originated that when you were with Stuff.
Yeah, with Stuff, yeah. Stuff Smith, "Crescendo on Drums," (HUMMING) Remember it?
Yeah. As a matter of fact I've got the record with me.
So is that when you first really got in with Jonah Jones.

I met Jonah as I told you when I was in Buffalo with Stuff. Stuff Smith, then's when I met Jonah and Stuff was there in Buffalo. In 1936 wasn't it, somewhere around there. Yeah, thens when I first met them and then we used to jam together all up around there, all together.
So you were mostly at the Onxy with Stuff.
